name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response relates to the context and the ongoing conversation.

name: Coherence
description: Assesses the logical flow and clarity of the response within the conversation.

name: Engagement
description: Evaluates how engaging and interesting the response is to encourage further conversation.

name: Contextual Awareness
description: Determines the extent to which the contestant considers the context and any interesting facts provided.

name: Empathy
description: Measures the degree of understanding and emotional intelligence displayed in the response.

name: Creativity
description: Assesses the originality and inventiveness of the response in contributing to the conversation.

name: Conciseness
description: Evaluates the ability to convey ideas clearly and succinctly without unnecessary filler.
